key_insight: Inverse-source accuracy depends strongly on matching the source model’s focality assumptions to the inverse method, with point-source-compatible methods performing best for point-like sources.
engineering_relevance: For EEG FEM workflows, choosing the source model and inverse solver jointly is critical because it changes localization quality, depth bias, and noise sensitivity.
method: Compared FEM forward solutions from Zeffiro Interface and DUNEuro source models: Whitney basis, Local subtraction, and divergence-conforming sources.
Tested inverse methods including SHAL1R, SKF, sLORETA, and dipole scanning.
Assessed localization quality using Earth Mover’s Distance, depth-bias scatter plots, and qualitative amplitude/focality comparisons.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports preliminary source-interpolation experiments and evaluation across multiple depth cases, showing Local subtraction matched expected local lead-field behavior while model-method compatibility drove performance.
watch_item: Patch-source models with broader spatial spread were more sensitive to added noise, so implementation should consider robustness and source-model assumptions carefully.
paper_title: Advanced EEG Source Models from the Perspective of FEM and Inverse Solutions
